citation.title: Diagnostics: Chapter 8 of the special issue: on the path to tokamak burning plasma operation
citation.authors: D. Mazon, G. Vayakis, M. Walsh, G. Yun, S.-H. Hong, et al.

topic: ITPA review of ITER diagnostics, including CXRS on metal walls, BES fluctuation feasibility, synthetic diagnostics and Kalman-type state estimation for control, and Bayesian integrated data analysis
own_question: Status, design and R&D basis of ITER diagnostics and their analysis and control use
actual_method_and_evidence: Review chapter. The CXRS subchapter describes JET metal-wall experience in which W nuisance lines complicate impurity CX ion-temperature fitting and require beam notches, Ne seeding and main-ion CX analysis. ITER CXRS time resolution is relaxed by diagnostic-neutral-beam modulation. Subchapter 10 describes model-based observers that fuse multiple diagnostics; density-profile Kalman estimation is supported by simulations only. Subchapter 11 presents Bayesian IDA, likelihoods, outlier-robust Student-t models and synergy between diagnostics, with synthetic ITER examples. No KSTAR CES nowcasting results are reported.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In metal-wall machines, CX impurity ion-temperature fitting can be degraded by overlapping tungsten nuisance lines, and CX measurement cadence can be constrained by beam modulation.
claim_checks.qualification: The evidence is JET and ITER-design experience, not KSTAR. It concerns impurity CX Ti, not electron or main-ion temperature.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Model-based state observers and Bayesian integration of heterogeneous diagnostics are established frameworks for estimating plasma quantities that a single diagnostic constrains incompletely.
claim_checks.qualification: The examples are simulations and post-shot analyses, not demonstrated real-time CES nowcasting.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not reported for CES report arrival. The ITER DNB-modulated CXRS time resolution is 200 ms to 1.5 s as a design value.
validation_if_relevant: Synthetic and simulation studies; there is no held-out-campaign validation.
forbidden_inferences: that prior CES/CXRS estimation work is noncausal
that the Kalman density observer was deployed in real time on ITER
that BES or ECEI carry Ti information
that this review validates our estimators
that ITER timing numbers apply to KSTAR
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include for background on CX impurity-Ti difficulties and on observer/IDA concepts; do not cite as a nowcasting precedent.
